name: Iligan Open 2017

venue.name: [Robinsons Place Iligan](http://www.robinsonsmalls.com/mall-info/robinsons-place-iligan)
venue.address: Macapagal Ave, Iligan City, Lanao del Norte

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) starts at Php 250.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on December 17, 2017 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
